title: AI Mindmeld: A Latent Interconnect Protocol
abstract: arXiv:2610.30215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs can act as scientific agents using tools to consult specialists and run experiments. Yet specialist information must enter their context, generally as text, images, audio or video: a bottleneck between models with rich, high-dimensional representations. We advocate direct representation exchange: a mindmeld conveying many properties, including information an LLM would not think to request. It should be extensible to new specialists, flexible across questions and tasks, and compositional across independently connected specialists without joint training.   The Latent Interconnect Protocol (LIP) learns connectors mapping specialist representations into LLM internal states. Training only connectors keeps this practical as LLMs grow and evolve. translated_title: AI心智融合：一种潜在互联协议
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以作为科学智能体，使用工具咨询专家模型并运行实验。然而，专家信息必须进入其上下文，通常以文本、图像、音频或视频的形式呈现：这在拥有丰富高维表示的模型之间构成了瓶颈。我们倡导直接的表示交换：一种“心智融合”，传递多种属性，包括LLM不会想到去请求的信息。该方法应可扩展至新的专家模型，灵活应对各种问题和任务，并能在无需联合训练的情况下，在独立连接的专家模型之间实现组合。潜在互联协议学习连接器，将专家模型的表示映射到LLM的内部状态中。仅训练连接器使得该方法在LLM不断增长和演进的情况下依然实用。我们将三个蛋白质专家模型和三个小分子专家模型连接到Gemma 3（4B和12B参数）以及Kimi K2.6（总参数1T，激活参数32B），并冻结所有预训练模型。独立训练的连接……
tldr: 提出潜在互联协议（LIP），通过仅训练轻量级连接器将专家模型的潜在表示直接映射到LLM内部状态，实现无需联合训练、可扩展且可组合的模型间直接知识交换，突破了以文本等多模态数据传递信息的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: The Latent Interconnect Protocol (LIP) trains lightweight connectors to map specialist models' latent representations directly into LLM internal states, enabling extensible and compositional cross-model knowledge exchange without joint training, bypassing the text-based information bottleneck.
